placements.why: Establishes the organizational category for intake rota design, hand-off protocols, and case-ownership continuity.
placements.title: Intake cadence and hand-off structures that maintain operational continuity
placements.frame: How should intake cycles, hand-off interactions, and operational artifact timing be structured to preserve context and ensure single-owner resolution?

placements.why: The segments argue that weekly hand-offs lose context by repeatedly resetting open cases from summary sheets, whereas fortnightly rotas with fifteen-minute overlap calls and end-of-rota summaries retain context long enough for single owners to close cases.
placements.title: Longer intake cycles and structured overlap hand-offs preserve case context to resolution
placements.frame: How does extending intake cycle duration and timing summary sheets at cycle close prevent context loss across active cases?
